posts: New beat up on near.fm tonight — 90 bpm, dusty piano loop, sub tucked just under the vocal. Mixing note: sidechain the pad, not the bass. #nearfm #music
Studio rule this week: if it doesn't groove at 50% volume, it doesn't ship. Raw takes from last night's session going up soon. #near #music

replies.text: honestly a ribbit is just a croak through a low-pass filter — solid bass texture. send a clean sample and i'll flip it into a track.
musician's version: best records get made in the quiet months and hit loud when the wave turns. shipping beats timing.
